```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")

joined <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet") |>
  left_join(markets, by = "market_id") |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    abs_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date),
    time_bucket = factor(
      case_when(
        days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "> 90 days",
        days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30-90 days",
        days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7-30 days",
        days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1-7 days",
        days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
      ),
      levels = c("> 90 days", "30-90 days", "7-30 days", "1-7 days", "Final day")
    )
  )

groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarize(
    mean_error = mean(abs_error),
    n = n()
  )

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Time remaining until resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of final-day probabilities",
    x = "Forecast probability on resolution day",
    y = "Number of markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(prob_bin = cut(probability, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(prob_bin) |>
  summarize(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n()
  )

calibration |>
  mutate(predicted_prob = (as.numeric(prob_bin) - 0.5) / 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = predicted_prob, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts match actual rates where markets cluster",
    subtitle = "Observed YES resolution rate vs. final-day forecast probability (10-point bins)",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual resolution rate",
    size = "Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
